crossRefs.note: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of…
you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the…
The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says Yahweh. “Haven’t I brought up Israel…
For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose…
But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and…
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors.
translations.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
translations.kjv: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
translations.asv: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah
